regions.summary: South foot of Dahong Mountain: Jingshan and the northern half of Zhongxiang (Hu Ji, Jiu Kou).

candidates.name: Jingshan
candidates.meaning: "Capital mountain": Sui county of 606, named after the Jing mountain.
candidates.fit: 48% of the region's people, 96% of the county; county seat (Xinshi) is inside; Tang Yingzhou was seated here too.
candidates.recognisability: Current county-level city.
candidates.source_note: 湖北省辖、荆门市代管的县级市，大洪山南麓，江汉平原北端

candidates.name: Dahongshan
candidates.meaning: "Great flood mountain"; also called Lülin Mountain, base of the Lülin rebels at the end of Western Han.
candidates.fit: Mountain sits on the Sui, Jingshan and Zhongxiang border, so this region is its south foot, but most of it lies north of the region.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 74 hits with 湖北, top ones about Jingshan and Suizhou.
candidates.source_note: 位于随州、京山、钟祥交界处，又名绿林山

regions.notes: Zhongxiang is split almost evenly with region 2; the old Zhongxiang centre (Yingzhong) is in region 2. A Dahongshan name may be wanted by the east/Suizhou batch.

regions.summary: Han River middle reach: Zhongxiang city (Yingzhong), Shayang and the old Jingmen city (Zi Ling) in Dongbao.

candidates.name: Zhongxiang
candidates.meaning: "Bell of auspice" (gathering of good omens): name granted by the Jiajing emperor in 1531 for his birthplace; old Chu secondary capital Jiaoying.
candidates.fit: Holds the Zhongxiang urban core (Yingzhong) and 40% of the people; 51% of the county.
candidates.recognisability: Current county-level city, national historic city, Ming Xianling tomb.
candidates.source_note: 嘉靖十年升安陆州为承天府，御赐县名为鍾祥，取祥瑞锺聚之意

candidates.name: Shayang
candidates.meaning: "Sandy expanse": Han River port town, called little Hankou.
candidates.fit: 36% of the people, 84% of the county.
candidates.recognisability: Current county; known river port.
candidates.source_note: 沙洋港口商埠兴旺，远近闻名的小汉口

regions.summary: Jingmen's new town (Duodao) with the Zhanghe reservoir, Dangyang's east and the Jingzhou district's north.

candidates.name: Jingmen
candidates.meaning: "Gate of Jing": the northern gate to Jingchu, 100 km north of Jingzhou.
candidates.fit: Region holds Duodao (90%), Dongbao's south and the Jingmen urban area; the prefecture city seat is split with region 2.
candidates.recognisability: Prefecture-level city; Jingmenzhou seat 1278-1911.
candidates.source_note: 地处荆州以北100公里，为荆楚之门户，所以称之为荆门

candidates.name: Zhanghe
candidates.meaning: "Zhang river": tributary of the Ju, dammed as Zhanghe reservoir.
candidates.fit: The river and reservoir (Zhanghe town) lie inside the region; runs south-west to Dangyang.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article is a disambiguation (several Zhang rivers); 141 hits with 湖北 but mostly about Jingmen.
candidates.source_note: 漳河 (沮水)，沮水支流，湖北境内流河

regions.notes: Jingmen's older centre (Zi Ling) is in region 2 but Duodao is the urban core now; Zhongxiang is already proposed there.

regions.summary: Tianmen city (Jingling) and surrounding Han River plain.

candidates.name: Tianmen
candidates.meaning: "Heaven's gate": county of 1726, after the Tianmen hill.
candidates.fit: 97% of the region, 83% of the city.
candidates.recognisability: Current county-level city.
candidates.source_note: 天门县 (县, 1726-1911) 今湖北天门市

candidates.name: Jingling
candidates.meaning: Ancient county and commandery (Qin to Qi) seated at today's Tianmen; home of Lu Yu and the Jingling literary school.
candidates.fit: Seat inside the region (Jingling subdistrict) but the old Jingling county also reached Qianjiang.
candidates.recognisability: 101 hits with 湖北, own articles on 竟陵郡 and 竟陵派, top ones about Tianmen.
candidates.source_note: 籍贯均为竟陵（今湖北省天门市）

regions.summary: Qianjiang city and the Jianghan oilfield between the Han River and Chang Lake.

candidates.name: Qianjiang
candidates.meaning: "Submerged river": Song county of 965 named for a local watercourse.
candidates.fit: 87% of the region, 99% of the city.
candidates.recognisability: Current county-level city.
candidates.source_note: 潜江县 (县, 965-1911) 今湖北潜江市西北三十里处

candidates.name: Jianghan
candidates.meaning: "Yangtze and Han": the plain between the two rivers; also the oilfield name.
candidates.fit: Qianjiang sits mid plain, but the plain covers all 11 regions.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article on 江汉平原; oilfield HQ in Qianjiang.
candidates.source_note: 江汉平原上还拥有湖北省唯一的规模油田：江汉油田

regions.notes: Jianghan would be a big claim for one region of a plain this size; the Wuhan or east agents may reach for it too.

regions.summary: Jingzhou city: Shashi and the old walled city (Jiangling).

candidates.name: Jingzhou
candidates.meaning: "Thorn province": one of the Nine Provinces; seat of Nanjun, Jiangling and Jingzhou fu.
candidates.fit: Holds the Jingzhou ancient city and Shashi; city centre of the prefecture.
candidates.recognisability: Prefecture-level city, Three Kingdoms fame.
candidates.source_note: 现在市区内有明代江陵城的遗址，是中国南方迄今保存最为完好的古城

candidates.name: Shashi
candidates.meaning: "Sand market": Yangtze river port.
candidates.fit: 65% of the region's people.
candidates.recognisability: Former city, now a district.
candidates.source_note: 荆州市沙市区

regions.notes: Jiangling (the historic name of the walled city) now only labels a county east of here in region 9.

regions.summary: Xiantao city on the lower Han River; old Mianyang seat at Miancheng.

candidates.name: Xiantao
candidates.meaning: "Immortal peach": modern town name that became the city.
candidates.fit: 99% of the region, 78% of the city.
candidates.recognisability: Current county-level city.
candidates.source_note: 仙桃市 (Xiantao)

candidates.name: Mianyang
candidates.meaning: "North of the Mian (Han) river": prefecture 1376-1911, Ming/Qing seat at Miancheng in this region.
candidates.fit: Seat inside the region; prefecture also covered Honghu and Jianli areas (region 10 and 11).
candidates.recognisability: 223 hits with 湖北, own article on 沔阳府; Sichuan Mianyang (绵阳) shares the pinyin, different characters.
candidates.source_note: 治所在玉沙县（今湖北省仙桃市西南）

regions.summary: Songzi and Zhijiang on the Yangtze where it leaves the gorges; Dongting neighbours across the river.

candidates.name: Songzi
candidates.meaning: "Pine flourishing": county moved here by refugees from Anhui in 337.
candidates.fit: 61% of the region, 99.7% of the county; county seat inside; 1,574 years as a county.
candidates.recognisability: Current county-level city.
candidates.source_note: 松滋县 (县, 337-1911) 今湖北松滋县西北老城镇

regions.notes: Gong'an (22% of the region) is proposed for region 9.

regions.summary: South Jingzhou on the Yangtze: Gong'an, Jiangling county, part of Shishou.

candidates.name: Gong'an
candidates.meaning: County from 557, named for Liu Bei, honoured as Lord Zuo ("Gong"); the "an" is peace.
candidates.fit: 57% of the region, 71% of the county, county seat Douhudi inside.
candidates.recognisability: Current county; Gong'an school of Ming literature.
candidates.source_note: 公安县 (县, 557-1650) 今湖北公安县斗湖堤

candidates.name: Jingjiang
candidates.meaning: "Jing river": the Yangtze between Zhicheng and Chenglingji, through old Jingzhou.
candidates.fit: Runs through Gong'an, Jiangling and Shishou and borders this region on two sides.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 144 hits with 湖北, flood diversion and dyke are known.
candidates.source_note: 因长江流经古荆州地区，又称荆江

regions.notes: Jingjiang is also spelled the same as Jiangsu Jingjiang (靖江), different characters.

regions.summary: Honghu city and the lake, lower Han mouth region.

candidates.name: Honghu
candidates.meaning: "Flood lake": remnant of the ancient Yunmeng marsh, also the city name.
candidates.fit: 67% of the region, 97% of the city; lake mostly in this region.
candidates.recognisability: Current city and own zh-wiki article on the lake.
candidates.source_note: 洪湖形成于约2500年前，是古云梦泽的残迹

regions.summary: Jianli county in the Yangtze loop north of Dongting.

candidates.name: Jianli
candidates.meaning: "Supervising profit" (a salt or tax office); county for 1,689 years.
candidates.fit: 94% of the region, 78% of the county.
candidates.recognisability: Current county-level city.
candidates.source_note: 监利县 (县, 222-1911) 今湖北监利县北

candidates.name: Yunmeng
candidates.meaning: "Cloud dream": the vast marsh of the old Chu heartland, silted into the Jianghan plain.
candidates.fit: The marsh covered the whole plain; Honghu is its remnant.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 28 hits with 湖北, famous in classics but a Yunmeng county exists in Xiaogan.
candidates.source_note: 位于今湖北省江汉平原的一个已消失的淡水湖

regions.notes: Yunmeng collides with Yunmeng county (east batch) so it is low.
